# AgriScan Technical Architecture Schematics

## Introduction
This document provides a detailed technical architecture overview of the AgriScan platform, outlining its core components, data flows, and interactions. AgriScan is designed with a decoupled, modular architecture to support real-time AI inference, complex data relationships, and robust financial integrations.
